model_scope.sampler_states: official CFG=4 ancestral DDPM-250 trajectory states

source_population.known_label_exposure_boundary: Visual labels predate this candidate, so this pool is discovery only. PTCV values have not been joined to them before this freeze.

mathematical_object.forward_corruption: X_t=alpha_t*X_0+sigma_t*epsilon with scalar alpha_t>0 and isotropic Gaussian epsilon
mathematical_object.identity: Jacobian_x m_t^c=(alpha_t/sigma_t^2) Cov(X_0|X_t=x,c), hence it is symmetric PSD
mathematical_object.learned_surrogate: the frozen raw conditional unclipped clean-latent prediction at a CFG-visited state
mathematical_object.boundary: A violation is a projected posterior-realizability defect, not a universal artifact theorem and not a CFG-Jacobian defect.

fixed_projection.kind: normalized 4x4 Hadamard channel modes tensor four orthonormal 2-D DCT modes

label_free_numerical_gates_before_any_jo.failure_action: STOP as numerically unresolved before labels are opened.

frozen_primary_score.class_standardization: For each class c, compute mean and sample SD of raw D_i over all 20 label-free paths; S_i=(D_i-mean_c)/(sd_c+1e-12).
frozen_primary_score.component_rescue_forbidden: skew-only, negative-eigen-only, minimum eigenvalue, finite secant, or maximum-checkpoint scores are descriptive only

fixed_simple_controls.single_path_temporal_change: mean over checkpoints of RMS(cfg_pred_xstart[k+1]-cfg_pred_xstart[k])/(RMS(cfg_pred_xstart[k])+1e-12), standardized per class; higher is worse
fixed_simple_controls.raw_conditional_cfg_gap: mean over checkpoints of RMS(raw_conditional_pred_xstart-cfg_pred_xstart)/(RMS(raw_conditional_pred_xstart)+1e-12), standardized per class; higher is worse

primary: tie-aware ROC AUC for S on 5 clear_bad versus 69 clean_good
exact one-sided class-stratified randomization p-value for higher S
each clear_bad sample's within-class percentile and rank
count of clear_bad samples above their class median
robustness: leave-one-positive-class-out AUC, recomputed without changing the score formula
leave-one-checkpoint-out AUC, recomputing the same ratio over the remaining fixed checkpoints and class-standardizing label-free
class-specific AUC for every class containing a clear_bad

advance_to_new_pool_only_if: every label-free numerical gate passes before labels are opened
primary higher-direction AUC is at least 0.65
at least 3 of 5 clear_bad samples are above their class-specific median
the exact higher-direction class-stratified randomization p-value is at most 0.10
primary AUC is not below any fixed simple control AUC
every leave-one-positive-class-out AUC with at least two remaining positives is at least 0.55
every leave-one-checkpoint-out AUC is at least 0.55
at least two positive-containing classes have class-specific AUC strictly above 0.5
decision_rule.strong_discovery_signal: All advance gates plus AUC>=0.75, at least 4/5 bad above class median, exact p<=0.05, all leave-one-axis AUCs>=0.60, and primary AUC exceeds every control by >=0.03.
decision_rule.failure_action: STOP as an artifact detector on this formulation. Do not flip sign, select one component/checkpoint/frequency/radius, or redefine the endpoint on this pool.
decision_rule.intervention_boundary: No intervention is authorized until the unchanged score passes an independent event-rich pool with fresh blinded labels.
